A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an AQC that is able to quench a SPAD at high count rate, with a timing jitter that is comparable with the best results reported so far in literature.
this is the first integrated AQC that can operate SPAD devices with a timing resolution of about a few tens of picoseconds and a single photon counting rate up to 50-80 Mcounts/s.
the new integrated AQC can be used as a stand-alone device, or as a basic building block for the development of compact SPAD arrays.

the new AQC can be used as a reference design for the development of a monolithic AQC array for SPAD detectors.
the new generation of high performance SPAD detectors can be operated with an AQC that can be fabricated in standard high-voltage CMOS technologies.
